Proposes to extend the validity / availability of the Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses (M O O E ) and Capital Outlay ( C O ) appropriations for another fiscal year (until December 31, 2020).

Intends to provide for the much-needed M O O E and C O to fund priority projects, financial assistance program, aid, and relief activities as well as for the maintenance, construction/repair, and rehabilitation of schools, hospitals, roads, bridges and other essential facilities of the national government.
